search_text: 联合密度$\varphi(x,y)$，条件密度$\varphi_1(y|x)$，求$P(\eta\le1/2|\xi\le1/2)$。 $\frac{\int_{-\infty}^{1/2}\int_{-\infty}^{1/2}\varphi(x,y)dxdy}{\int_{-\infty}^{1/2}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\varphi(x,y)dydx}$ $\frac{\int\varphi(x,y)dxdy}{\int\varphi(x,y)dx}$ $\int\varphi_1(y|x)dxdy$ $\frac{\int_{-\infty}^{1/2}\int_{-\infty}^{1/2}\varphi(x,y)dxdy}{\int_{-\infty}^{1/2}\varphi(x,y)dy}$ 条件概率等于$P(\xi\le1/2,\eta\le1/2)/P(\xi\le1/2)$，对应选项1。
